title: The Senator’s Anxious Protector
front_description: Chancellor Palpatine suggests that threatened Senator Amidala enlist the aid of her old Jedi ally, Obi-Wan Kenobi. It has been years their paths have crossed, and in that time Kenobi's remarkable Jedi apprentice, Anakin Skywalker, has grown into a handsome young man who harbors a great, sometimes unbearable love for this young woman under his protection.
back_description: Star Wars creator / director George Lucas sets up a shot for  Episode II
